A.notes: A has a clear editorial catalog idea and carries it through the product spec, list styling, kiln diagram, and restrained palette. It is the cleaner e-commerce read: prices, shipping, care, and add-to-cart are immediate and well organized. From the scroll frames, motion seems mostly limited to section reveals plus a scroll-linked kiln indicator/highlight, so it supports the story but does not add much dramatic progression.

B.notes: B has the stronger signature: the oversized serif, kiln-arch framing, and ash-mark illustrations create a distinct identity that still fits the brief. The scroll strip shows more legible motion intent, especially the firing-duration blocks expanding in proportion as the story section arrives. It is slightly less rigorous as a product page, and there are minor craft quirks in spacing/details on mobile, but all measured access and reduced-motion checks pass.

raw.why: B wins narrowly because its concept is more original and its scroll-driven storytelling is clearer, while still meeting the commerce and accessibility requirements.
